verbatim-int.reason: Documented 0.0.55 YAML 1.2.2 conformance fix: the verbatim tag !<int> names exactly the URI 'int', not tag:yaml.org,2002:int. The new refusal fails closed with a located frontmatter error, nothing silently changes value, and no frontmatter in this repository or the create-zfb templates uses verbatim tags (rg over docs/, crates/zfb/templates/, tests/). Consumer-visible: must be called out in the zfb and zfb-md-wasm changelog lanes when #4173 applies the pin.

verbatim-core-uri-int.reason: Documented 0.0.55 conformance fix: !<tag:yaml.org,2002:int> 7 is the core int tag by its full URI and now resolves to 7, where 0.0.53 refused it. Newly accepted input; no previously accepted document changes value.

verbatim-core-uri-str.reason: Same conformance fix for the core str tag by full URI: it now resolves to the string "7" where 0.0.53 refused it. Newly accepted input; no value change for previously accepted documents.

alias-depth-over-max.reason: Documented 0.0.55 resource-safety tightening: an alias can no longer build a value deeper than max_depth (128), matching the existing non-alias depth limit. Only a pathological, more than 128-deep aliased structure is newly refused, with a located error. This strengthens the frontmatter resource boundary and is not a compatibility regression for realistic frontmatter.
